title: AI models
description: Which models serve each feature. Changes take effect without a restart, after a test and activation.
loadFailed: The model configuration could not be loaded.
notReloaded: This API process has not reloaded the configuration yet
envMode: .env mode: changes made here are ignored

missing.title: Missing models
missing.body: These purposes have no model, so their features are off for everyone. Members' materials wait and will be processed automatically once a configuration with a suitable model is activated.

RAG.label: Cooperative chat (RAG)
RAG.hint: Answers from the canonical wiki knowledge.

PROMOTION.label: Wiki proposals
PROMOTION.hint: Turning notes into a draft article.

EMBED.label: Embeddings
EMBED.hint: Vectors of the knowledge index (a change rebuilds the index in the background).

TRANSCRIBE.label: Transcription
TRANSCRIBE.hint: Speech to text for recordings in notes.

IMAGE_EMBED.label: Atlas: photo vectors
IMAGE_EMBED.hint: Embeddings of atlas photos and crops for “Recognise” (a change rebuilds the atlas index in the background).

OCR.label: Reading scans (OCR)
OCR.hint: A vision model reads document pages without a text layer.

removal.provider_in_draft: Used in a draft of changes

errors.endpoint_not_allowed: This address is not on the list of allowed servers (the server administrator sets it in .env).
errors.cloud_requires_https: A cloud server must use https:// on port 443.
errors.credentials_in_url: The address cannot contain a username or password; give the API key in its own field.
errors.provider_type_not_allowed: This provider type is not supported.
errors.provider_in_use: The provider is used by the active configuration.
errors.provider_in_index: The provider serves the search index (current or being built): change the embedding model first.
errors.provider_in_draft: The provider is used in a draft of changes: change the assignments in the draft or discard it.
errors.provider_removed: This revision uses a removed provider; it cannot be restored.
errors.model_in_use: The model is used by the active configuration.
errors.model_exists: This model has already been added.
errors.model_disabled: The model or its provider is disabled.
errors.embed_dimension_only_for_embed: The vector dimension applies only to embedding models.
errors.capability_mismatch: This model does not suit this purpose.
errors.provider_not_cleared: This purpose processes private data: choose a model from a provider cleared for private data.
errors.endpoint_not_clearable: This address is not on the list of servers that may receive private data (LLM_PRIVATE_DATA_ENDPOINTS in .env).
errors.provider_cleared: The provider is cleared for private data: withdraw the clearance first, then change the address.
errors.cloud_not_allowed: Cloud models are off in the server configuration (LLM_ALLOW_CLOUD).
errors.probe_required: Test the model first — activation needs a successful test from the last few hours.
errors.embed_model_unavailable: The embedding model is unavailable or its provider is not cleared for private data.
errors.generation_not_found: This index version does not exist.
errors.generation_not_building: This index version has already been built or cancelled.
errors.not_draft: This revision has already been activated; make changes in a new draft.
errors.not_archived: Only an archived revision can be restored.
errors.rate_limited: The hourly test limit has been reached. Please try later.
errors.prompt_or_preset: Enter your own prompt or choose a ready scenario.
errors.duplicate_models: Each model can be chosen only once.
errors.removeFailed: The provider could not be removed.
errors.listFailed: The model list could not be fetched.

providers.cloudOff: · cloud off in the server configuration
providers.privateOff: · features on private data are off
providers.listsHint: The server administrator sets these lists (.env); this console cannot widen them.
providers.name: Name

removeDialog.title: Remove provider: {name}
removeDialog.body: It disappears from the list with its models ({count}). The saved API key will be deleted{cleared}.
removeDialog.archives: The provider was used in earlier revisions: it will be archived so the change history stays complete. Those revisions cannot be restored.
removeDialog.deletes: The provider was not used in any activated revision: it will be deleted completely.

clearance.notClearable: Not on the server's private-data list
clearance.stepUp: Clearing a provider for private data needs a recent sign-in. Sign in again and repeat the action.
clearance.intro: Private notes, anonymisation, wiki drafts, photo descriptions and embeddings may go to {url}{external}
clearance.external: — an external server, outside the cooperative.
clearance.members: Members will see this on the “Where your data is processed” page. Clear only providers the cooperative has a data processing agreement with (or its own servers).
clearance.withdrawBody: Private data stops going to this provider at once.
clearance.withdrawActive: The provider serves the active configuration: features on private data that use it will stop until you assign them another cleared model. The system will not switch them to another provider by itself.

providerForm.name: Name (lower-case letters, digits, “.”, “_”, “-”)
providerForm.local: Local server: the data does not leave the cooperative's infrastructure.
providerForm.cloudBlocked: A cloud API, but cloud is off in the server configuration (LLM_ALLOW_CLOUD). The provider cannot be added here.
providerForm.cloud: A cloud API: suitable only for the cooperative chat (RAG) and the playground.
providerForm.notAllowed: An address outside the list of allowed servers.

checks.image_embed: Photo embeddings (the same object closer than another)

probe.dimensionMismatch: The dimension does not match the index ({expected}).

models.added: Model added. Test it before use.
models.noList: The server returned no model list.
models.embedHint: The model test reads the vector dimension. Changing the embedding model builds a new index version in the background.
models.transcribeHint: A server with the /audio/transcriptions API (e.g. whisper). The model test transcribes a short Polish test recording.

routing.draft: Draft of revision {number} (based on {base}). The changes take effect after activation.
routing.active: Active revision {number}. To change something, create a draft.
routing.privateHint: Private data: only providers cleared for private data
routing.rebuildHint: After activation the index rebuilds in the background (the “Indexes” tab); the old version works until then.
routing.activated: Revision {number} is active. The servers switch over on the next call.
routing.cloudWarning: Requests of these features will go to a cloud model: {purposes}. Canonical wiki content will be sent to an external provider.
routing.unprobed: Without a recent test: {models}. The server will refuse the activation until you test them.

index.none: No versions: the index will be built once a model is configured.
index.loadFailed: The indexes could not be loaded.
index.intro: Changing the embedding model builds a new index version in the background. Until it is done, search uses the old version and its own model; then the versions swap, and the old one is deleted after a transition period. Cloud models are limited to {perMinute} items a minute.
index.textItems: A model change will reprocess {count} items.
index.rebuilding: Started building a new index version.
index.cancelled: The build was cancelled; the current version keeps working.
index.atlasItems: A model change will reprocess {count} photos.

history.restored: The configuration was restored as revision {number}.
history.body: This revision's configuration will be activated as a new revision (the history does not change). The current server rules apply, so for example cloud models are refused while cloud is off.

playground.intro: The playground uses neither the knowledge base nor notes: the models see only this prompt. Answers are not stored; the audit log keeps a hash of the prompt.
playground.ownLabel: Prompt (do not paste personal data or the content of notes)
